mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of UNRATE above 4.3% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days, reflecting investor concerns about labor market tightness and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4.3%, or IC > 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (housing demand) below their 5% monthly thresholds signals weakening aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls > 5% and HOUST falls > 10% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite both GDPC1 and HOUST declining below thresholds, or IC > 0.03 over any 12-month period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained rise in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days, as investors anticipate higher interest rate hikes to curb inflation.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0% in a late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% in late-cycle periods, or IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals tight monetary policy, elevating borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5%, or IC > 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PAYEMS above 150,000 indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite PAYEMS consistently rising above 150,000, or IC < 0.03 over any 12-month period.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of INDPRO above 105 signals robust industrial production, reflecting underlying economic strength and supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO exceeding 105, or IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDPC1 (total demand) and RSAFS (sales) below their 2% monthly thresholds signals weakening demand across sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls > 2% and RSAFS falls > 5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS declining below thresholds, or IC > 0.03 over any 18-month period.
